tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"answers":["R1"],"new":"The maids, grown fond and familiar after so many trays carried in and teas poured, watched them go and lingered a while.","old":"The maids, grown long familiar and fond through the coming and going of trays and of tea, watched the receding figures go and stood a while lingering.","reason":"The trays and tea are kept, but the doubled verbs and nominal pile-up were translation stiffness, not the author's strangeness.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"answers":["R3"],"new":"To the north, as far as sight reached, deer-fences stood stark and clappers ran in a far line, and the mountain paddies looked busy with autumn.","old":"To the north, as far as the eye can reach the gaze is far, the deer-fences stand stark and the clappers run far in a line, and the autumn of the mountain paddies looks busy.","reason":"The Japanese period is long but not tautologous; the doubled 'far' was a calque, not scenic strangeness.","replace_all":false}
